status: Frozen before this reviewer saw explorer-053 or current matching outcomes
selectionMethod: Purposive coverage across analytical engineering, practical electronics, health-adjacent science, language and ethics, arts, communication, organization, teaching, uncertain interests and access contexts. This is a stress-test sample, not a prevalence estimate. Original holdout cases are evaluated separately; they are not used to tune the engine. Fresh holdout biographies were not opened.
sourceAccess: Only biography fields were consumed for case expectations; response histories, recommendation outputs, correlations and salaries were not inspected or calculated.
interpretation: Families are relevance expectations for discovery, not a closed gold-label set. Absence from this ledger is not an error. Strong claims need stronger answer evidence than biography themes alone.
